title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing core.create check in example data generation and BreezingForms import in…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla Visforms extension versions 1.0.0-5.6.4 and 6.0.0-6.2.1 allows backend users to create records without proper permission checks. The issue arises because example data generation and BreezingForms import functionalities do not verify the core.create permission, enabling unauthorized record creation.
